newsitem.title: THAILAND: SCCF plans mergers, wants bank licence.
newsitem.headline: SCCF plans mergers, wants bank licence.

text.p: Thai broker Siam City Credit Finance and Securities Plc plans to merge with SCF Finance and Securities Plc and Siam City Syndicate Plc, the firm said in a statement on Tuesday.
To help facilitate the merger Siam City Credit will issue 78 million new shares at 10 baht per share in a 2:3 rights issue.
Following completion of a merger the firm would seek to absorb ailing finance and securities firms, bring in foreign partners, and apply for a commercial banking licence, the firm said.
The merging firms are units of Siam City Bank Plc.

The Thai bourse halted trading in the shares of SCF Finance and Securities and Siam City Credit Finance and Securities Plc on Tuesday morning as it was awaiting details of a previously announced merger proposal between the two firms. ($1 = 31 baht)
